newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ to release tankan survey, comments separately.
newsitem.headline: BOJ to release tankan survey, comments separately.

text.p: The Bank of Japan will announce the results of its quarterly short-term corporate survey or "tankan" for August at 11 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Wednesday, but it will hold a separate press briefing on the survey at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT) on the same day, a BOJ official said on Monday.
Until the previous survey in May, the BOJ released the tankan results and comments simultaneously at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT).
Masayuki Matsushita, director of the BOJ's Research and Statistics Department, will comment on the tankan results at the briefing.
